description: Send one prompt to any Obscurify.ai model and get its reply. Useful for delegating a subtask to a cheaper or specialised model, getting an outside view, or using a model you don't otherwise have. Prompts go through zero-data-retention routes and are not stored by Obscurify.ai. Default model: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash (fast and cheap). Use list_models to find other model IDs. For follow-ups that need earlier turns use chat; to compare several models use second_opinion.

max_tokens.description: Cap on the reply length in tokens (default 4096). Reasoning models spend some of these thinking.

model.description: Model ID such as "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5" or "openai/gpt-5.5". Default: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash.

prompt.description: The full prompt. The model sees nothing else, so include any context it needs.

reasoning_effort.description: How hard a reasoning model should think. Ignored by models without reasoning. Omit for the model's default.

show_reasoning.description: Include the model's reasoning text, when it returns one (default false).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, 0-2. Omit for the model's default.

name: ask
title: Ask a model
